reviews.title: What a fantastic experience.

reviews.title: Must improve their customer service and communication
reviews.text: Flight was delayed by roughly 90 mn and we did not get any info before just about the theoritical departure time whereas they knew it much before. As a matter of fact we learnt the previous flight departed with more than one hour delay, thus the return flight from Paris and our flight could not be on time. No info on the various boards at the airport, no info at check-in. And of course no voucher to buy a drink or snack to compensate the passengers. On board service was ok for a one hour flight, seat comfortable.
reviews.author: GGGClub

reviews.title: The right flight in the right moment
reviews.text: I did not know Volotea. I needed to return home urgently and thus booked the flight in the last minute. The fight I took was the right one at the right time. Moreover, it was smooth and with pleasant staff.

reviews.title: First flight with them but will definitely use again
reviews.text: Our outward flight took off early, very easy boarding. Our return flight took off exactly on time. Staff on both flights very friendly and helpful
reviews.author: Marie L

reviews.title: First Time - Good Experience
reviews.text: I rarely fly within countries abroad and usually opt for train travel and I never fly budget airlines. On this particular day I was flying from San Sebastian, Spain to Malaga, Spain. The weather in San Sebastian turned for the worse and it was bad enough for the flights to be diverted to Bilbao. Volotea informed us that since our flight was diverted that they would have to bus us to Bilbao and fly from there. Of course, I was not happy, but this was due to the weather and it was hard to place blame. We waited about 90 minutes for the bus to arrive and then there was communication that Volotea was able to get a plane to come to San Sebastian with the improved weather. We were then processed and were able to board the plane. All in all we were delayed for 2 hours. Once on board, the professionalism of the crew was great. I think many people have become quite demanding of airlines recently, and I think given the circumstances that this was a great experience of this company.
reviews.author: Gusto Gregorio

Other issues are just not very happy or nice staff on the plane... one flight attendant was willing to share her anxiety with the plane, broke down in tears and had to 'hide' for most of the flight, while 2 other attendants were just rude to customers... this needs to be fixed

reviews.title: In good and bad times..... I trust Volotea
reviews.text: Sardenga is one of my favortie routes. But Volotea has also taken me to other destiantions (Sicily, Croatia, Puglia) Through ups and downs of delays due to circumstances beyond their control of diffrent airport strikes. This is my GO TO airline no doubt. Not only because of convinience to the Destinations I like but also the professionalism of the staff and the clean planes. I deal with a lot of new personnel arriving and when the questions of getting around comes up. Volotea is my recommendation. I would like to see more destinations added to Germany, Croatia and Bosnia & Herzegovina :)

reviews.title: Update to unsuccessful booking
reviews.text: An email arrived 48 hours after my original attempt at booking, complete with booking number. However, this is not acceptable as the "uncertainty" had destroyed my trip and I had cancelled my plans. With less than 48 hours to flight time it is too late to book equivalent accommodation. I will not fly and will ask my credit card provider to demand a refund.
reviews.author: Alan H

reviews.title: Never flying with Volotea again!
reviews.text: In my Volotea-account it was shown that I could bring 2 pieces of luggage on my flight but when I arrived at the check-in I was only allowed to bring 1 bag. I was then charged 50 euros for the extra bag and the ladies at the check-in told me I could get the money back because it was a mistake from the company and website, not mine. However, after reaching out multiple times over email I finally got a response (about a month or 2 later), saying they wouldn't give me back the money. I am extremely unsatisfied by the customer service from Volotea and will surely not be booking with them again.

And before they use an excuse for being outside of their control, they were every time the only flight delayed in the entire airport

Frustrating and not sure it’s allowed to only use machines. A bug issue is of course not selective as an option in the machines….
